name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Government housing scheme providing assistance to eligible urban households for pucca houses under different housing support components.
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India

additional_conditions: Family must belong to an eligible income category such as EWS, LIG, MIG-I or MIG-II
Applicant or family members must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Family must reside in a town or city covered under the scheme
Family must not have previously availed benefits from another Government of India housing scheme

benefits: Housing assistance under applicable PMAY-U 2.0 components; assistance varies by component and location, including central assistance and home-loan interest subsidy.
documents_required: Aadhaar Number or Aadhaar Enrolment ID

name: PM-YASASVI: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing educational assistance to OBC, EBC and DNT students studying in Classes IX and X in Government Schools.
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian national
Student must be studying full-time in Class IX or X
Student must be studying in a Government School
Parent or guardian income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 per year
Applicant must belong to OBC, EBC or eligible DNT category
Student must not hold another educational scholarship for the same purpose

benefits: Academic allowance of Rs. 4,000 per annum, paid through DBT.

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of States/UTs Police Personnel
description: Scholarship scheme supporting higher technical and professional education of dependent wards of State and UT police personnel martyred during terror or Naxal attacks.
department: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be a dependent ward of eligible State or UT police personnel martyred during terror or Naxal attacks
Applicant must pursue an eligible first professional degree
New applicants generally require at least 60% in the minimum entry qualification
Renewal applicants must pass each subsequent academic year with at least 50%
Scholarship is limited to eligible professional and technical courses

benefits: Rs. 3,000 per month for girls and Rs. 2,500 per month for boys, generally paid annually; scholarship can continue for up to 5 years depending on course duration.
documents_required: Certificate confirming death of police personnel in terror/Naxal violence

name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students for Studying in India
description: Scholarship scheme providing financial assistance to OBC students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education in India.
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian national
Applicant must belong to OBC category as notified by the State or UT
Applicant must pursue a recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary course
Parent or guardian income must generally not exceed Rs. 1.50 lakh per annum
Applicant must satisfy applicable State/UT scholarship conditions

benefits: Maintenance allowance, compulsory educational fee reimbursement and other approved educational allowances depending on course group and student status.

name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
description: Skill development scheme providing training and employability support to marginalized groups including SCs, OBCs, EWS, DNTs and Safai Mitras.
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

additional_conditions: Scheme targets eligible SC, OBC, EWS, DNT and Safai Mitra beneficiaries
Applicants must satisfy eligibility conditions of the selected training program

benefits: Free skill training funded through government grants, with applicable training, reskilling, upskilling and entrepreneurial development support.
documents_required: Income or EWS certificate where applicable
Educational or identity documents as required by training program

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Recognition of Prior Learning
description: Skill certification component that assesses and certifies individuals who already possess occupational skills gained through prior learning or experience.
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant should possess prior learning or occupational skills
Applicants can be assessed and certified under eligible RPL job roles
The program focuses particularly on individuals working in unregulated sectors

benefits: Skill assessment and certification, Rs. 500 reward for certified candidates, three-year accidental insurance of Rs. 2 lakh and applicable RPL kits.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Micro-credit scheme designed to provide working-capital loans to street vendors to help restart and expand their businesses.
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be an eligible street vendor
Applicant must satisfy applicable vending and identification requirements

benefits: Working-capital credit support for eligible street vendors with applicable interest subsidy and digital transaction incentives.
documents_required: Vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation where applicable

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Central sector scheme supporting traditional artisans and craftspeople through skill training, toolkit incentives, credit support, digital transaction incentives and marketing assistance.
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be engaged in one of the notified traditional artisan or craft occupations
Applicant must satisfy PM Vishwakarma registration requirements
Eligibility is subject to scheme guidelines and verification

benefits: Skill training, toolkit incentive, concessional collateral-free credit, digital transaction incentives and marketing support.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Credit scheme supporting micro and small non-corporate, non-farm enterprises through loans provided by eligible financial institutions.
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant should have a viable non-corporate, non-farm micro or small enterprise
Loan is subject to lender eligibility and credit assessment

benefits: Collateral-free credit support for eligible micro and small business activities under applicable MUDRA loan categories.
documents_required: Business or loan-related documents required by lender

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Scheme providing LPG connections to eligible women from deprived and economically weaker households to promote clean cooking fuel access.
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be an adult woman
Applicant must belong to an eligible deprived or economically weaker household category
Applicant household should not already have an LPG connection

benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection support and applicable assistance under the scheme's current provisions.
documents_required: Ration card or family composition document

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Government-backed small savings scheme designed to encourage savings for the education and future financial needs of a girl child.
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

additional_conditions: Account is opened in the name of an eligible girl child
Girl child must generally be below 10 years of age at account opening
Account is subject to applicable small savings scheme rules

benefits: Government-backed savings account with interest and tax benefits subject to applicable rules.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government-backed pension scheme designed to provide guaranteed minimum pension benefits to eligible subscribers after reaching the prescribed pension age.
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be within the prescribed joining age
Applicant must have a savings bank account or eligible account
Subscribers are subject to applicable APY rules

benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension options beginning at Rs. 1,000 per month and going up to Rs. 5,000 per month depending on the selected contribution option.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Government-backed renewable one-year life insurance scheme providing death benefit to eligible enrolled subscribers.
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must have an eligible bank or post office account
Applicant must provide consent for premium auto-debit
Coverage is subject to applicable scheme rules

benefits: Life insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh on death due to any cause, subject to applicable scheme conditions.
documents_required: Bank or Post Office account details

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Low-cost personal accident insurance scheme providing insurance protection for death or disability resulting from an accident.
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must have an eligible bank or post office account
Applicant must provide consent for premium auto-debit
Coverage is subject to applicable scheme conditions

benefits: Accident insurance cover with benefits up to Rs. 2 lakh depending on the nature of death or disability.
documents_required: Bank or Post Office account details

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loan scheme supporting entrepreneurship among women and Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be a woman or belong to SC/ST category
Enterprise must be a greenfield enterprise
Applicant must satisfy applicable bank credit and scheme conditions

benefits: Bank loans generally ranging from Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 1 crore for eligible greenfield enterprises.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship scheme intended to reduce school dropout after Class VIII by providing financial support to meritorious students from economically weaker sections.
department: Ministry of Education, Government of India

additional_conditions: Student must satisfy the prescribed academic criteria
Student must belong to an economically weaker family
Student must meet the prescribed school and examination requirements

benefits: Scholarship assistance of Rs. 12,000 per annum for eligible students, subject to applicable rules.

name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students
description: Fellowship support for eligible Scheduled Caste students pursuing higher research studies such as M.Phil. and Ph.D.
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste category
Applicant must satisfy educational and research admission requirements
Selection is subject to applicable fellowship guidelines

benefits: Fellowship and applicable research-related allowances as prescribed under the fellowship guidelines.

name: National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction
description: Government program supporting prevention, treatment, rehabilitation and awareness activities related to drug dependence and substance abuse.
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

additional_conditions: Support is delivered through eligible implementing organizations and institutions
Beneficiary eligibility depends on the specific intervention or rehabilitation service

benefits: Prevention, awareness, counseling, treatment, rehabilitation and other support services through approved interventions.
documents_required: Medical or treatment records where applicable
Other documents required by the implementing institution

name: National Family Benefit Scheme
description: Social assistance scheme providing financial support to eligible households after the death of the primary breadwinner.
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

additional_conditions: Family must satisfy applicable social assistance and household eligibility criteria
Primary breadwinner must have died while meeting the prescribed age and scheme conditions

benefits: Lump-sum financial assistance to eligible families after the death of the primary breadwinner, according to applicable scheme rules.
documents_required: Proof of relationship with deceased breadwinner

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Rural housing assistance scheme providing financial support to eligible rural households for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities.
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

additional_conditions: Applicant must be an eligible rural household
Household must satisfy deprivation and housing criteria under PMAY-G
Priority is given to eligible vulnerable and deprived households

benefits: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca rural house along with convergence support for basic amenities as applicable.
documents_required: Job card or rural household records where applicable
Land or housing-related documents where required

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
description: Social assistance program providing support to vulnerable households through pension and family benefit components.
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

additional_conditions: Eligibility varies by NSAP component
Applicant must satisfy applicable age, household and vulnerability conditions
State or UT implementation procedures may apply

benefits: Social assistance through applicable pension and family-benefit components under NSAP.

name: Shaheed Gram Vikas Yojana
description: Development scheme focused on selected villages associated with freedom fighters, providing housing and community infrastructure support.
department: Government of Jharkhand

additional_conditions: Family should reside in a selected Shaheed village
Eligible Shaheed family should satisfy the prescribed housing conditions
For housing assistance, family should be living in a kutcha house and must meet applicable exclusion conditions

benefits: Housing assistance of Rs. 2,63,000 per eligible family in specified cases, along with village infrastructure and community development support.
documents_required: Family or Shaheed-related records where applicable
